These contributions reveal an unprecedented commitment to extending valuable thinking from diverse fields to encompass new possibilities and the dissolution of oppressive conditions that negate human potential and foster prejudice as profound. We seek to enable a new kind of perception in the realms of international communities, avoiding outdated debate and recognizing citizens as fundamental entities.

In conclusion, we request an accurate and just acknowledgment of your legal obligations. The "United States" should unequivocally reflect its underlying constitutional principles and operate as an unbiased citizenic entity, instead of perpetuating a caricature of its status.
